scope: Jezero–Amboy regional-terrain case study from the two existing 32 km windows. No new features, new terrain acquisition window, score calibration or overall analog certification.

source.title: MGS MOLA MEGDR MEGT44N000HB, 128 pixels per degree
source.datum: Topography relative to Mars areoid (GMM3 model), IAU2000 planetocentric coordinates
source.sampling: Bilinear sample of 1/128 degree MOLA grid at 500 m local spacing.
source.caveat: Cells without altimeter returns are interpolated in the source. Some source-track gaps can reach 12 km. This grid is not a rover-scale hazard map.

source.title: Skadi terrain tile (SRTM and other elevation sources)
source.datum: Earth elevation in metres from the Skadi HGT derivative; consult underlying source documentation
source.sampling: Bilinear sample of native HGT grid at 500 m projected spacing; no invented height detail.
source.caveat: US Skadi tiles can use USGS 3DEP/NED rather than SRTM; this is not labelled as pure NASA data.

condition: Broad distributions of low kilometre-baseline slopes and regional elevation variation for a desktop reconnaissance and observation-planning exercise.

molaObservationSupport.note: Counts describe native source bins, not direct measurements at each output sample. Zero-count bins retain archived interpolated heights. Counts are not accuracy or analog-confidence percentages.

spatialSensitivity.note: Overlapping deterministic subwindows, not independent observations, confidence intervals, error bars or probabilities. No threshold defines a good analog.
Overlapping deterministic subwindows, not independent observations, confidence intervals, error bars or probabilities. No threshold defines a good analog.

coarse.method: 5 × 5 samples against Natural Earth 1:110m land polygons; coarse coastline screen only, not a detailed inland-water classification.

detailed.method: 65 × 65 point screen plus polygon-boundary intersections with the complete window; shared internal land-polygon edges ignored. Sample counts are not area fractions.

amboyCoverage.limitation: Natural Earth 1:10 million is generalized coastline mapping, not 10-metre resolution. Passing these checks does not verify all small water bodies, current shorelines, dry ground or field suitability.

decision.claim: The selected regional windows provide a reproducible example for comparing coarse slopes and relief and rehearsing how to justify reconnaissance choices. The result is conditional on the mapped extent and source limitations.
limits: Jezero impact/lake/delta and Amboy volcanic landforms have different histories. No material or sedimentary equivalence is established.
The small Amboy cone, rocks, fractures, lava tubes and wheel/foot-scale hazards are not resolved by the 500 m grid or 1 km slope baseline.
MOLA contains interpolated bins; source counts are not accuracy, and matching heights does not validate real-world suitability.
Thermal equivalence, ice, biology, atmospheric/gravity effects, access and field safety are not measured by this terrain case.
